title.narrative: Strategic Communication and Support to Mass Media in the Republic of Moldova (2023-2027)

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to support the successful implementation of democratic reforms in the Republic of Moldova, through increased visibility of EU assistance for the Republic of Moldova, and targeted support for independent media, strategic communications and building resilience to disinformation, including through improving media and information literacy. The communication and visibility activities undertaken in the framework of this project should be implemented in the context of the EU candidacy role of the Republic of Moldova and make clear reference to the Association Agreement (AA) including the Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (DCFTA) and Association Agenda 2021-2027.

The project aims to ensure an increased access of citizens¿ to strategic communication products on EU assistance and to ensure the access to diversified media content and increase capacities and sustainability of media outlets.
